mapper.sql: left join basket_member_profile mp on mp.member_id = r.member_id and mp.is_delete = 0 left join basket_member_account acc on acc.id = r.member_id and acc.is_delete = 0 left join basket_player_profile p on p.id = r.player_id and p.is_delete = 0
mapper.select:
select r.id, r.request_no as requestNo, r.player_id as playerId, r.member_id as memberId, mp.nickname as nickname, acc.email as email, p.player_no as playerNo, r.change_type as changeType, r.platform as platform, r.old_display_game_id as oldDisplayGameId, r.new_display_game_id as newDisplayGameId, r.request_status as requestStatus, r.submit_time as submitTime, r.reviewed_time as reviewedTime from basket_player_platform_change_request r
where r.is_delete = 0 and r.request_no like concat('%', #{requestNo}, '%') and mp.nickname like concat('%', #{nickname}, '%') and acc.email like concat('%', #{email}, '%') and p.player_no like concat('%', #{playerNo}, '%') and r.platform = #{platform} and r.change_type = #{changeType} and r.request_status = #{requestStatus} and r.member_id = #{memberId} order by r.submit_time desc, r.create_time desc

select r.id, r.request_no as requestNo, r.player_id as playerId, r.member_id as memberId, mp.nickname as nickname, acc.email as email, p.player_no as playerNo, r.change_type as changeType, r.platform as platform, r.platform_account_id as platformAccountId, r.old_display_game_id as oldDisplayGameId, r.new_display_game_id as newDisplayGameId, r.new_normalized_game_id as newNormalizedGameId, r.proof_file_id as proofFileId, r.request_status as requestStatus, r.submit_time as submitTime, r.reviewed_time as reviewedTime, r.reviewer_id as reviewerId, r.review_remark as reviewRemark, r.result_platform_account_id as resultPlatformAccountId from basket_player_platform_change_request r
where r.id = #{id} and r.is_delete = 0

select id, request_no, player_id, member_id, change_type, platform, platform_account_id, old_display_game_id, new_display_game_id, new_normalized_game_id, proof_file_id, request_status, submit_time, reviewed_time, reviewer_id, review_remark, result_platform_account_id, create_time, update_time, is_delete from basket_player_platform_change_request where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0
mapper.update: update basket_player_platform_change_request set request_status = #{toStatus}, reviewer_id = #{reviewerId}, review_remark = #{reviewRemark}, reviewed_time = #{reviewedTime}, result_platform_account_id = #{resultPlatformAccountId}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and is_delete = 0 and request_status in #{s}
